hypothesis: Dense opening-to-wall attention is insufficient for globally competing wall hosts; a hybrid sparse MIta host route with dynamic budget should improve host accuracy and opening quality.
controls: hybrid MIta without geometric distance prior
hybrid MIta with shuffled opening tokens

gate.screen: Host accuracy or routed Opening F1 improves without opening presence, interval, type, validity, or watertightness regression.
gate.promotion: Hybrid MIta beats dense and static-budget controls on calibration and disjoint holdout.
gate.confirmation: At least 4/5 seeds preserve direction; paired 95% CI excludes zero.
gate.mechanism: Route budget varies by case and shuffled opening tokens degrade host accuracy.

claim_boundary: Architecture and budget contract only; Opening F1 remains at the established consumer baseline until matched runs pass.
